components.name: Bubble Button
components.description: Primary candy button: pink gradient pill with a gloss band, white Fredoka label. Copy prompt, Analyze, Share result, Download PNG.
components.css: .ds-bubble { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bubble-top, #F29BE8) 0%, var(--bubble-mid, #DC68D4) 52%, var(--bubble-low, #C64DC2) 100%); color: #fff; font: 600 20px/1 "Fredoka", "Nunito", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(130,30,120,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset, 0 -4px 8px rgba(150,30,140,0.22) inset, 0 12px 22px -10px rgba(200,70,190,0.7), 0 2px 4px rgba(170,60,170,0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.2s; } .ds-bubble::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18px; right: 18px; top: 3px; height: 52%; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 70%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%); pointer-events: none; z-index: -1; } .ds-bubble:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: saturate(1.08); } .ds-bubble:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset, 0 -2px 6px rgba(150,30,140,0.25) inset, 0 6px 12px -8px rgba(200,70,190,0.7); } .ds-bubble:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8657D6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-provs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-prov { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 6px 0 14px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1.5px solid; font: 600 16px/1 "Fredoka", "Nunito", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-openai { --ring: #4FB497; background: #D9F5EE; border-color: #B3E6D8; color: #245C4C; } .ds-gemini { --ring: #6B8FDB; background: #DCE6FC; border-color: #BCCDF3; color: #2A4A8A; } .ds-claude { --ring: #E08F79; background: #FDE3DF; border-color: #F4C7BD; color: #8E3F2F; } .ds-tick { position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 50%; width: 15px; height: 15px; margin-top: -7.5px; opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.4); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.2s; } .ds-prov[aria-checked='true'] { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ring) inset, 0 10px 18px -12px var(--ring); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-prov[aria-checked='true'] .ds-tick { opacity: 1; transform: none; } .ds-prov:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-prov:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-prov:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8657D6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; } .ds-choice { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-choice input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1.5px solid var(--lilac-line, #DCD2FA); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); color: var(--ink-2, #5C4A80); font: 600 17px/1.15 "Fredoka", "Nunito", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-choice:hover span { background: #fff; } .ds-choice input:checked + span { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #A88AF3 0%, #9572EA 50%, #8460E0 100%); border-color: transparent; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(70,30,140,0.35); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45) inset, 0 10px 18px -12px rgba(110,70,210,0.9); } .ds-choice input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid #8657D6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-choice input:active + span { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.northStar: The Love Letter That Does Maths
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Love Letter That Does Maths"**

The page is one phone screen from a pastel sticker book. A lavender field holds a blush-white screen. Blush-pink and lilac panels sit on it, with glossy liquid-chrome heart stickers tucked at their corners and four-point sparkles in the gaps. The lettering is chunky rounded Fredoka. The title has a glossy violet-to-orchid fill with a white rim. Buttons are candy bubbles with a gloss band across the top. The drop zone is a dashed love-letter outline.

The tone is cute, but the content is exact. Reply times, "you start N% of chats" and dry-reply counts are worked out on the phone and set as big Fredoka numerals with tabular figures. The AI writes only the one-line verdict, and its card is credited under the quote ("Claude's verdict"). The rejected anti-reference is the category default: a dark "AI analyser" dashboard.

The same world is drawn twice. The live page is built in CSS, and the share card is a 1080x1920 canvas (`js/card.js`) that repeats the palette, the glossy title, the lanes, the tiles and the verdict card at story size.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender field, blush-white screen, pink and lilac panels.
Pink is You and the main action; lilac is Them and selection.
Fredoka for anything read at a glance, Nunito for sentences, JetBrains Mono only for text you paste into an AI.
Raster chrome heart stickers and SVG four-point sparkles are the ornament.
Gloss everywhere: white inset top lines, candy gradients, shadows tinted violet.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Pink is You, route 1 and the main action. Lilac is Them, route 2 and selection. Every paired element follows the split: route cards, number hearts, avatars, reply bars and stat tiles.

rules.name: The Plain-Names Rule
rules.body: AI providers appear as plain names in tinted chips (mint, sky, peach), never as logos. Those three tints are not used anywhere else.

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: The share card in `js/card.js` repeats the `:root` hex values as literals on a canvas. Change a colour in both places, or the card and the page drift apart.

rules.name: The Glance-Or-Read Rule
rules.body: Anything a student reads at a glance (titles, buttons, numbers, choices, headings) is Fredoka. Anything read as a sentence is Nunito. Mono appears only for text meant to be pasted into a machine.

rules.name: The Exact Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number the stats produce is set in tabular figures, so the counts look measured, not decorative.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow takes the colour of the world (plum, violet, orchid). Grey and black shadows are out, and so are hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Gloss Line Rule
rules.body: Raised panels, pills and the phone carry a 1px white inset line along the top edge. It is what makes a pastel panel read as glossy plastic rather than paper.

rules.name: The Nothing Sharp Rule
rules.body: No corner is under 10px, and nothing is square.

dos: Do keep the Two Inks split: pink for You, route 1 and the main action; lilac for Them, route 2 and selection.
Do tint every shadow plum, violet or orchid, and give raised panels the 1px white inset gloss line.
Do set titles, buttons, numbers, choices and headings in Fredoka, sentences in Nunito, and only paste-able machine text in JetBrains Mono.
Do set every computed number in tabular figures.
Do credit the AI under the verdict quote ("Claude's verdict") in Nunito 700 Ink 3.
Do change `js/card.js` whenever a `:root` colour changes; the share card repeats the palette as literals.
Do give every generated raster a `.json` provenance sidecar (model, reference, prompt, date) and keep its source in `.impeccable/assets-src/`.
Do let `prefers-reduced-motion` stop the stickers, the bar race and the typing dots.
donts: Don't show provider logos; providers are plain names in their mint, sky and peach chips.
Don't put a badge or label above the verdict quote; the credit goes under it.
Don't use grey, black or hard offset shadows.
Don't draw hearts or sparkles with emoji or icon fonts; use the chrome stickers, the inline SVG heart and the four-point SVG sparkle.
Don't set white bubble labels below 18px; white on candy pink holds up only at that size with the plum text shadow.
Don't use square or near-square corners (under 10px).
Don't turn a screen into a dark "AI analyser" dashboard.
